question: What claim is made about the even-wise person who, while burning, acts in relation to the tip of nectar and the tip of essence?
premises: A reference is made to the tip of nectar.
A reference is made to the tip of essence used as instrument.
Even a wise person, while burning, is the subject of the statement.
inference: The verse presents a condition in which even the wise person, while burning, engages with the tip of nectar and the tip of essence.
uncertainties: The result of that action is not stated in this verse alone.
plain_english: At the tip of nectar, with the tip of essence, even the wise person, while burning, also...
